C-ADAPTIVE-ACTION-CENTER-V2.IntentSummary: Supersede the unmerged first Action Center change and deliver a minimal complete vertical from the topbar through immutable document intake, exact-object routing, conservative protocol merge, stable adaptive ranking, compatibility regression, responsive UI and release evidence.

T-001.Title: kafedra-flow-intake: define exact upload, processing, route and fallback states

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The flow saves the immutable source first, tracks the same documentId, opens the exact materialized object, preserves partial success and sends only ambiguity to review.
The superseding flow preserves legacy calendar safe-default behavior by requiring existing callers and tests to enter the calendar form through a registered Action Center action.

T-002.Title: kafedra-design: specify stable desktop and mobile hierarchy

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The rendered center has one primary upload affordance, three fixed recommendation slots, fixed groups, deterministic search, keyboard focus restoration and equivalent desktop and mobile completion paths.
The global create button and a concrete calendar-day plus always open the center before the user chooses task or event.

T-003.Title: kafedra-motion: use restrained interruptible disclosure with explicit zero-duration reduced-motion fallback

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The center uses a short opacity and translation disclosure only for orientation, contains no routine bounce or full-screen animation, remains clear in static frames and computes zero animation and transition duration under prefers-reduced-motion.

T-004.Title: kafedra-data: preserve immutable evidence and conservative meeting identity

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Protocol matching uses source identity or one exact number-and-date candidate, fills only missing values, keeps conflicts and evidence, creates no duplicate agenda item on retry and requires no schema change.
Action ranking remains allowlisted and rank-only; automatic document routing never records a preference event.

T-005.Title: kafedra-feature: implement registry, launch adapters, universal intake and exact-object routing

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The existing topbar, calendar date action, manual-plan event listener and document worker are connected end to end without duplicating forms or materializers; action frequency is rank-only and server-allowlisted.
Calendar task and event launch adapters apply existing UI preferences only after the user selects the action, preserving the new center and the previous safe-default contract.

T-006.Title: kafedra-design-audit: independently verify implemented clarity, safety and responsive behavior

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Audit evidence verifies one clear primary path, stable geometry, source and progress visibility, preserved input on error, keyboard and focus, desktop, mobile and prefers-reduced-motion with no blocker or major finding.

T-007.Title: kafedra-tests: verify ranking, merge, exact route, compatibility and degraded paths

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit tests prove context precedence over frequency, allowlist rejection, exact routing and conservative protocol merge with idempotent retry.
Project Playwright CI proves three stable recommendations, exact day date, exact uploaded plan, preserved adaptive calendar defaults, desktop, mobile and true zero-duration reduced motion.

T-008.Title: kafedra-release: prove unchanged schema and offline dependency surface

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Version and schema remain unchanged, backup and restore and offline and release checks pass, no required CI job is unexpectedly skipped, and no CDN, cloud, mandatory LLM or runtime package dependency is added.
